scenes.narration: I know I am not always easy to love.
scenes.image_query: I know I am not always easy to love.

scenes.narration: Some days, I carry a silence I do not know how to explain.
scenes.image_query: Some days, I carry a silence I do not know how to explain.

scenes.narration: But you never ask me to become easier.
scenes.image_query: But you never ask me to become easier.

scenes.narration: You hold my hand when it shakes.
scenes.image_query: You hold my hand when it shakes.

scenes.narration: You love me, even on the days I forget how to love myself.
scenes.image_query: You love me, even on the days I forget how to love myself.

scenes.narration: And that is how I know you are not just someone I love.
scenes.image_query: And that is how I know you are not just someone I love.

scenes.narration: You are the place my heart feels safe.
